name: race
_comment: A clean windward-leeward race: beat under the J1, tack, bear away and run
the kite wardrobe with a gybe in it, then round up and beat again. No
faults — this is the stream to point the ingestion pipeline at when you
want to know whether it recovers the polar in polars/fleet.js.
TWD is 225. Every leg's heading is chosen so the TWA lands inside its
sail's band, and the lap covers BOTH tacks — a sign error in the app's
TWA/tack derivation cannot hide in a one-tack course.
